allRegistrationsDisabledRegression.behavior: An empty registration list clears marks and cached derivations, cancels queued work, and retires deadlines. Re-enabling the same registration reruns both completed and previously blocked files without accepting the retired completion. Warning deduplication remains scoped to the original registration across absence.
allRegistrationsDisabledRegression.evidenceType: Native executable lifecycle tests informed by the pinned hook; not a new dual-baseline runtime oracle.
allRegistrationsDisabledRegression.validation: All 1259 workdeck-tui library tests passed with zero ignored; workdeck-tui all-targets Clippy with denied warnings passed.

postDeferredProjectionValidation.scope: Compiled subprocess concurrency, source reads, cancellation, deadlines, saved-note updates and live cell painting. Does not complete the source hook interval.

settledGenerationFastPath: Unchanged fully cached generations with no pending requests reuse their published map without rebuilding retention/publication maps. Retired completion messages are still drained. Lifecycle tests cover invalidation, reordered/removed registrations and late-result cleanup. This is not a measured release-benchmark result.
provenanceGate: For the pinned Hunk baseline, cargo xtask port audit verifies the reorder/removal fixtures name both exact pins and resolves their recorded source blob at each pin. This check validates provenance, not capture honesty or complete behavioral coverage.

registrationReorderRegression.behavior: Reordering existing registrations reuses cached contributions, changes merged mark order without extension calls, and retains map identity on the next unchanged frame.
registrationReorderRegression.evidenceType: Native executable regression compares marks, calls and identity transitions with the dual-pin source trace in port/hunk/oracles/highlighter-registration-reorder.json.
